# Hubber, 12 Reels for $1,500

> Hubber is a video production company serving businesses in the Greater Orlando area, Florida. It plans, scripts, films and edits 12 vertical Reels from a single shoot day at the client's location. Hubber is part of the Cinnamon Group.

## Offer

- One-time content shoot: $1,500. 12 custom scripts, one on-site recording session, professional on-camera direction, 12 fully edited Reels, ready-to-post vertical delivery, no monthly commitment. Booking through the page adds 12 custom Reel covers at no additional cost.
- Consistency Plan: $2,700 per month. 24 custom scripts, two recording sessions, 24 edited Reels and 24 custom Reel covers every month, with an initial three-month commitment.

## How it works

- Planning: Hubber studies the client's business, audience, services and communication goals, then writes twelve scripts the client approves before filming.
- Filming: one organized recording session at the client's business or an approved location in the Greater Orlando area, with on-camera direction throughout.
- Delivery: the footage becomes 12 edited Reels with captions, audio treatment, color correction and social-first pacing, sized for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube Shorts.
